p: Represents an entry in a drawing list, allowing customizable drawing actions to be performed on a given GUI layout node using an associated canvas.

pre.code: void Execute(Gui gui, LayoutNode node, SKCanvas canvas)

p: Executes a drawing operation using the provided GUI, layout node, and canvas.

ul.li: gui (Gui): The GUI context to utilize for the drawing operation.
node (LayoutNode): The layout node in the GUI hierarchy where the operation should take place.
canvas (SKCanvas): The canvas on which the drawing operation is performed.
